#### Show plot


```{r plot_radar_grid_sexOrientation_demo_group}
#| fig-width: 4.5
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-align: center

targets::tar_read(plotdata_sexorientation_racegender) |>
  plot_radar_grid()   +
  scale_radial_mpxnyc() +

  theme_mpxnyc_nomargin()
```
